function.name: OleCreateLinkToFile
function.description: This function is a stub for creating a link to a file in OLE (Object Linking and Embedding). Currently, it does not implement any functionality and returns an error code.

parameters.name: lpszFileName
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that contains the name of the file to link to.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object.

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies the drawing options.

parameters.name: lpFormatEtc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device to use for subsequent rendering or data transfer operations.

parameters.name: pClientSite
parameters.description: Pointer to the location of the IOleClientSite interface on the container application.

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: OleCreateLink
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is supposed to create a link object from a moniker.

parameters.name: pmkLinkSrc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface on the moniker that identifies the object to be linked to.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface the caller is to use to communicate with the resulting link object.

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies whether the presentation data for the object being created is to be drawn from the linked object or is to be updated and maintained in the link object.

parameters.name: lpFormatEtc
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that defines the presentation data to be used for the object being created.

parameters.name: pClientSite
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the client site object where the linked object is to be loaded.

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object to be used in the creation of the link object.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: OleGetIconOfClass
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It is intended to get the icon of a class.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is a reference to the class identifier.

parameters.name: lpszLabel
parameters.description: This is a long pointer to an OLE string that represents the label.

parameters.name: fUseTypeAsLabel
parameters.description: This is a boolean value that indicates whether to use the type as a label.

function.return_type: HGLOBAL, represents a handle to a global memory block. However, in this function it always returns NULL.

function.name: OleGetIconOfFile
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It is meant to get the icon of a file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to the file whose icon is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: use_file_as_label
parameters.description: A boolean value that specifies whether to use the file as a label or not.

function.return_type: HGLOBAL, but currently returns NULL as the function is a stub.

function.name: OleRegEnumFormatEtc
function.description: This function is a stub, not yet implemented, used to enumerate the FORMATETC structures for a specified CLSID.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: This is a CLSID for which the FORMATETC enumeration is requested.

parameters.name: dwDirection
parameters.description: This is the direction of the enumeration.

parameters.name: ppenumFormatetc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IEnumFORMATETC interface.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, represents the return type of the function. In this case, it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.
